customManagers.description: BUN_VERSION in workflow env blocks; CI fails when it drifts from packageManager
BIOME_VERSION in workflow env blocks; CI fails when it drifts from package.json
The bun binary COPY inside the compose file's dockerfile_inline, which the docker-compose manager does not read

packageRules.description: Every bun pin (packageManager, workflows, Dockerfiles, compose) moves in one PR, outside the weekly group, since a bun upgrade needs its own look (docs/architecture/toolchain-traps.md)
Biome's package, workflow pins and biome.json $schema in one PR, outside the weekly group so new lint rules cannot red-wall it
